name: Ovex FurCut Cargo Short
description: A wide-leg cargo short hemmed high with an unfinished raw cut — intentionally so. The leg openings are generously sized and the interior seams are flat-felled to avoid matting fur geneware. The waistband is a wide elastic-and-button hybrid that sits comfortably over a thick fur coat at the hip. Available in khaki, dark olive, and washed navy.
functionality: Wide leg openings and interior flat seams prevent fur compression and matting; elastic waistband accommodates hip fur density variation
what_it_says: You've got fur and you're not going to sweat through tailored trousers on a long shift.
story_hooks: The cargo pockets are deeper than standard — someone has been using them to move small packages through checkpoints that don't look closely at a furry person's shorts.
A character finds a note tucked in the flat seam, sewn in deliberately, from someone who wore these before them.
